title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Branch Office of Department)
(1) A branch office of each department of the relevant High Court may be established in an outlying division to handle receipt and processing of cases, participation in trials, preparation and processing of records and documents, and preservation of records and books, and such branch offices shall be operated in an integrated manner. <Amended on February 20, 2008>
(2) The President of the High Court may assign general-service court officials of the High Court to work in such branch offices. <Amended on May 20, 1995; December 10, 2013>
(3) With consent of the President of the relevant District Court, the President of the High Court may concurrently assign District Court officials to duties in such branch offices. <Amended on May 20, 1995>
(4) Officials concurrently serving under paragraph (3) shall be under the direction and supervision of the President of the relevant District Court, except with respect to service related to affairs of the outlying division, for which they shall be under the direction and supervision of the President of the High Court. <Newly Inserted on February 5, 2010>
(5) The senior court administrative official serving in the branch office shall act on behalf of the head of each department of the relevant High Court with respect to affairs of the branch office. <Amended on May 20, 1995; February 5, 2010>
